description.text: The ninth Sword & Shield set, released on 25 February 2022 with 186 cards, 172 and 14 secret rares, and a Trainer Gallery of 30 more, numbered apart, with special art of Pokémon and Trainers. It brought in Pokémon VSTAR, played on top of a Pokémon V like a VMAX, each with a VSTAR Power a player can use once a game, led by Arceus VSTAR. It was the first set with the F regulation mark.
